run_simulation: run a Concordia AI companion conversation simulation with a specified scenario and language model
setup_model: set up a language model and sentence embedder for Concordia simulations using an API key
save_results: save simulation results to a timestamped structured JSON file in the output directory
list_scenarios: list all available AI companion conversation scenarios with their names and descriptions
main: run the CLI to execute a Concordia conversation simulation with configurable model and scenario options
